facts.fact: Alison Gillwald (UCT/Research ICT Africa) wrote on 2019-10-03 that various government departments had developed policies in their sectoral silos but there was no overarching digital policy to coordinate the state and the public and private sectors; the document's own date is used, as the article gives none for the observation.

systems.system: Presidential Commission on the Fourth Industrial Revolution
systems.country_label: Commission on the Fourth Industrial Revolution

note: An op-ed; the one fact is the author's statement that no overarching digital policy existed. The 4IR commission is named without a scope that makes it a strategy.
